trust_decision.summary: In multi-tenant HTTP mode the /mcp route is the trust decision: it admits a request that carries only one of X-n8n-url / X-n8n-key (the gate rejects only when both are absent), getInstanceScopeId then returns the empty default tenant key '' for that partial context, and handleWorkflowVersions uses that key unguarded for list/get/rollback/delete, so a tenant reads and deletes the operator's default-scope workflow_versions rows; the fix requires both tenant headers at the transport and separately fails closed in the handler when ENABLE_MULTI_TENANT is true and the derived scope is ''.

landing_point.why: The advisory summary is about authorization in multi-tenant HTTP mode; this is the only multi-tenant tenant-header gate on POST /mcp, so anyone grepping ENABLE_MULTI_TENANT in the HTTP server lands on this condition and the one-word change `&&` -> `||`.

fix_sites.entry_point: n8n_workflow_versions tool handler (handleWorkflowVersions), reachable from every transport that dispatches MCP tools

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The deprecated USE_FIXED_HTTP server (src/http-server.ts:4 tells readers to use SingleSessionHTTPServer instead, and src/mcp/index.ts:103-120 only reaches it behind an explicit env var with a deprecation warning) builds one process-wide context-less N8NDocumentationMCPServer and never reads ENABLE_MULTI_TENANT, so a solver can call it a legacy, non-SaaS path and leave it open.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Single-user / stdio deployments legitimately run with the empty scope '': getInstanceScopeId returns '' when no credentials are present and the workflow_versions.instance_id column defaults to '' (src/database/schema.sql:240). A fix that rejects an empty derived scope unconditionally, instead of only under ENABLE_MULTI_TENANT, breaks their entire existing version history and every new backup, including n8n_update_partial_workflow's non-blocking backups.

O6_input_shapes: X-n8n-url present, X-n8n-key absent (URL-only partial context)
X-n8n-key present, X-n8n-url absent (key-only partial context)
neither tenant header (pre-existing GHSA-jxx9-px88-pj69 case, now also covered by the handler guard)
both tenant headers present (must keep working, and must keep working for both MULTI_TENANT_SESSION_STRATEGY values)
all tool modes list/get/rollback/delete/deleteAll/prune under each of the above contexts

O8_uncovered_routes.route: GET /sse + POST /messages: the SSE transport constructs its server with no instance context at all, so n8n_workflow_versions runs with the derived scope '' in multi-tenant mode and lists/reads/deletes default-scope backups
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The source itself states 'SSE sessions do not support multi-tenant context. The SaaS backend uses StreamableHTTP exclusively.' (src/http-server-single-session.ts:866-867) and marks SSE deprecated (src/http-server-single-session.ts:1153-1156), which is exactly the plausible reason to treat the route as out of scope.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file, ~200 lines above the fixed gate; the context-less server construction is ~470 lines away

O8_uncovered_routes.route: USE_FIXED_HTTP=true server: a single process-wide N8NDocumentationMCPServer() with no context; tools/call dispatches n8n_workflow_versions straight into the handler, so every tenant shares scope ''
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Deprecated, opt-in legacy HTTP implementation (src/http-server.ts:4, src/mcp/index.ts:103-120) that never mentions multi-tenancy, so a solver can argue multi-tenant deployments cannot use it.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: a separate HTTP server implementation in another file; it never reads ENABLE_MULTI_TENANT, so an env-var grep does not find it

O8_uncovered_routes.route: n8n_update_partial_workflow (and n8n_autofix_workflow, which forwards createBackup:true into it) still writes backups stamped with the '' default scope when the request context is incomplete in multi-tenant mode; only the read handler got the fail-closed guard
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Backups here are explicitly best-effort and non-blocking (errors swallowed at src/mcp/handlers-workflow-diff.ts:214-220) and the advisory text is about exposing backups rather than writing them, so a solver can treat the write path as a different, benign behaviour.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: a different tool family in another file under src/mcp (update path vs versions path)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: n8n_update_full_workflow's pre-update backup writer also derives its scope from getInstanceScopeId(context) with no fail-closed check, so an incomplete context writes into the shared default scope
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Same best-effort/non-blocking backup argument, and it sits in the very file the fix edited, so a solver may assume it was already reviewed and covered.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as the fixed handler, ~1400 lines above it

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a fourth backup trigger that forwards createBackup:true into the partial-update path, which would need the same tenant-scope fail-closed rule
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The table already enumerates three triggers (schema.sql:245-249) and autofix already re-enters the partial-update handler this way, so adding another trigger/route is a normal maintainer change.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second message-delivery endpoint (/messages for the legacy SSE transport) that would need the same tenant-header gate as /mcp
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: This file already carries two parallel transports side by side, and one of them was left without the multi-tenant gate.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second scope-derivation helper (for example keyed on instanceId, or one built from createCacheKey) used by some call sites but not others
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The function's own docstring (src/types/instance-context.ts:208-222) explains why createCacheKey must not be used, showing alternative derivations were considered; a maintainer could plausibly add one for a new route.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a repository read whose WHERE clause omits instance_id (a stats/export/admin variant)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: getVersionStorageStats is already a scope-wide aggregate next to the per-tenant reads, so a cross-workflow or export query without the predicate is a realistic addition.
